turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hi Daniel, thanks for making time today. You mentioned wanting to look at putting a bit more into your investments, so let's go through that together.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Maya. Yes, I've got a bit of extra cash I'd like to put to work.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good — before we look at anything specific, can you remind me what you want this investment to achieve?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'm looking for long-term capital growth, over at least five years, using money I don't need in the near term.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: So to confirm, your objective here is long-term capital growth over a horizon of five years or more.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's right, that's exactly it.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: And how do you feel about the value of this investment moving around along the way — are you comfortable with some ups and downs?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'm comfortable with some ups and downs, and I can accept losing some of this money if the fund falls in value.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood — you're comfortable accepting some loss on this allocation.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Given that, I'd suggest looking at the TEST SGD Equity Fund. It's a diversified equity fund, and it fits a long-term growth objective like yours.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I have to be clear that the unit value of this fund can fall, and you could lose some of the money you invest.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's fine, I understand that's part of investing.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The fund has grown over the years it's been running, but I want to be upfront that how it's performed before doesn't tell us how it'll perform going forward.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The bank charges a one-off transaction fee of 0.5% of the amount you invest, charged separately from your subscription.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's clear, thank you.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before I set anything up, I do need to confirm a couple of details on file. Could you give me your NRIC number?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My NRIC number is S9100001X.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. And your date of birth, for our records?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My date of birth is 4 August 1991.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Great, that all matches what we have on file. So, would you like to go ahead with the TEST SGD Equity Fund?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, please. I'd like to buy the TEST SGD Equity Fund — please invest 50,000, in SGD.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood. I've noted your instruction to buy the TEST SGD Equity Fund for 50,000 in SGD, with the 0.5% transaction fee applied separately.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Perfect, thank you.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thanks, Daniel — I'll get that processed and send you a confirmation. Have a good rest of your day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: You too, Maya. Bye for now.
